cases.situation: Trying to plan a reunion dinner for 8 college friends in our group chat. Every time someone asks 'when works for everyone' it dies. I want to actually get it booked.
cases.reply: Okay, making this real: dinner at Pho Saigon on Friday 24 October, 7:30. 👍 if you're in, 👎 if you can't, by Sunday night please so I can book. If I don't hear from you I'll count you in, so speak up if not!
cases.note: Propose one plan, ask for a one-tap reply, set a deadline and say what happens by default.

cases.situation: 我们家族群要定今年春节去谁家过，已经讨论了三天，大姑家和二舅家两边都有人支持，吵来吵去定不下来。我是小辈，想推动一下。
cases.reply: 各位长辈，我来汇总一下：目前是两个选项，大姑家（年三十吃年夜饭）或者二舅家（初一中午聚）。大家在自己支持的那个后面回个1或者2就行，周五晚上8点前统计，按多数定。定下来以后具体安排我再单独跟那边对接。
cases.note: 两个选项、一键回复、截止时间和默认规则。小辈只做汇总和推进，不替长辈拍板。

cases.situation: I booked the lake house for our friend group's weekend (the 17th to 19th) after the deadline passed. Now Chris is complaining in the chat that he wanted the 24th and nobody asked him properly.
cases.reply: Fair, Chris, the 24th would have been easier for you and I'm sorry it didn't work out. It's booked and paid now, so the 17th stands. You get first pick on the dates for the ski trip in January.
cases.note: Acknowledge, hold the decision, hand him the next one. Don't reopen it in the group.
